# clearinghouse-pym-45979
- **URL:** https://clearinghouse.net/case/45979/ and https://clearinghouse.net/case/46097/ · **Accessed:** 2026-08-25 · **For:** v1→v2 response round, confirming which Clearinghouse case IDs match which houses-of-worship enforcement case
- **What it establishes:** Case 45979 IS *Philadelphia Yearly Meeting of the Religious Society of Friends v. U.S. Department of Homeland Security*, U.S. District Court for the District of Maryland, No. 8:25-cv-00243 (filed Jan. 27, 2025). On Feb. 24, 2025 Judge Theodore D. Chuang granted in part a limited preliminary injunction ordering DHS "to abide by the 2021 Policy at Plaintiffs' place of worship" while denying a nationwide injunction; DHS appealed the injunction to the Fourth Circuit as No. 25-1512, and the Fourth Circuit AFFIRMED on Aug. 18, 2026 (published, unanimous panel: Agee, Harris, Keenan, with Senior Judge Keenan writing; standing found on attendance-decline evidence; no abuse of discretion on the RFRA merits) — opinion at https://www.ca4.uscourts.gov/opinions/251512.P.pdf, see also https://law.justia.com/cases/federal/appellate-courts/ca4/25-1512/25-1512-2026-08-18.html. Case 46097 IS *Mennonite Church USA v. U.S. Department of Homeland Security*, U.S. District Court for the District of Columbia, No. 1:25-cv-00403 (filed Feb. 11, 2025); Judge Dabney L. Friedrich DENIED the preliminary injunction on Apr. 11, 2025 for lack of Article III standing; plaintiffs appealed to the D.C. Circuit (No. 25-5209).
- **Key passages:** 45979: injunction "order[ed] DHS to abide by the 2021 Policy at Plaintiffs' place of worship"; denial of "a mandatory nationwide injunction." 46097: plaintiffs "failed to show standing under Article III"; a plaintiff "cannot manufacture standing by incurring costs in anticipation of non-imminent harm."
- **Reliability:** secondary (Civil Rights Litigation Clearinghouse, U. Michigan — high-quality docket-tracking source)
- **Relevance to this project:** Settles the case-ID cross-mapping: 45979 = Philadelphia Yearly Meeting (D. Md., injunction granted in part, 4th Cir. No. 25-1512); 46097 = Mennonite Church USA (D.D.C., PI denied). The essay's pairing is correct, including the Aug. 18, 2026 Fourth Circuit affirmance in No. 25-1512.
